release_notes: **No more broker calls overnight from an open dashboard.** With the dashboard left open, its once-a-minute refresh kept quoting Kite (about 6 calls a minute) and, after midnight, Dhan, all night long, even with no strategy on Dhan. Outside market hours the dashboard now makes no broker calls for its cards, and during market hours the cards share one market-open check instead of each making their own. **Multi-sim results page no longer crashes when opened.**
